GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 004 (21 Dec 45) ESS/FI
(SCAPIN - 467)
APO 500
21 December 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : Imperial Japanese Government
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo
SUBJECT : Application of Fusan Business Office of the Hiroshima Railway Bureau
1. Reference is made to C.L.O. Memorandum No. 917(2.1), dated 6 December 1945.
2. Permission for the remittance of funds from Japan to Korea as requested in the application of the Fusan Business Office is denied.
3. Such action will be taken regarding this concern as is deemed appropriate by Korean authorities.
4. An acknowledgement of the receipt of this memorandum is directed.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
/s/ H. W. Allen
/t/ H. W. ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst. Adjutant General
